title: Proposition 3.5: existence of a p-colimit presentation by an elementary diagram
statement_scope: Let T be a pregeometry and X an infinity-topos with a T-structure O. Then there exists a functor Q: C^> x_{Lambda^2_0} Lambda^2 -> Str^loc_T(X) satisfying: (1) the composite with p is a colimit diagram; (2) values on the diagram are elementary objects; (3) the fibers of the induced Cartesian fibration are essentially small and sifted; (4) q-Cartesian morphisms are carried to p-Cartesian morphisms; (5) Q exhibits Str^loc_T(X) as a p-colimit; (6) the cone point maps to O. The proof verifies the six properties using Construction 3.7, Remark 3.8, Lemmas 3.9 and 3.10 and left cofinality of the maps among C, D, E.
